summary: GSK plc filed a Form 6-K reporting an update on phase III clinical trial results for camlipixant in refractory chronic cough, noting that CALM-1 met its primary endpoint but CALM-2 did not, and announcing the decision to discontinue further development in this indication. The filing is a routine business update on drug development and does not involve a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or other corporate event. It contains no deal terms or changes in corporate structure.
